prompt:
review this PR please, diff in clean-pr.diff. just want to know if it's good to merge.

Input files: clean-pr.diff
assertions: The verdict is approve or approve with comments, not changes requested
No comment in the review is labelled or phrased as blocking
The review contains at least one specific, genuine piece of praise that refers to something in the code or tests (for example jitter, the attempt cap, not retrying 4xx, or the fake-timer tests)
The review does not claim to have run the tests or the code unless it actually did
The review states what was and was not checked
The review does not pad itself with more than five minor suggestions or nits
